% Variant of Christian Feuersanger's PGFPlots smooth example, 2dplots:44-52.
% Same data and axes; only the plot handler, tension and dash style change.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{width=7cm,compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}
    \addplot+ [
        smooth cycle, tension=1, dashed,
    ] coordinates {
        (0,0) (1,2) (2,3)
    };
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
